experiment.title: FNSPID economic-value risk-rule search
experiment.objective: Select a causal aggregate negative-news risk rule on 2013-2019 and test whether its downside-adjusted economic value persists on 2020-2023 after costs and against an equal-average-exposure control.
experiment.evidence_role: exploratory chronological model selection on already-opened historical outcomes

chronology.fold_rule: four consecutive near-equal blocks, each repriced independently with entry and final-liquidation costs
chronology.boundary: evaluation returns do not enter candidate generation, ranking, constraints or tie-breaking

normalisers: strictly-prior rolling mean and sample standard deviation
strictly-prior exponentially weighted mean and standard deviation
composition: multiply the HAR exposure by the news multiplier
cap the HAR exposure at the news multiplier

selection.primary_daily_utility: net_return minus 5 times squared negative net_return
selection.fold_comparator: constant HAR multiplier with the same mean candidate exposure inside that development fold
selection.selection_score: minimum annualised fold utility difference versus the equal-exposure constant
eligibility: development mean exposure ratio versus HAR is between 0.50 and 0.95
each fold mean net return is no worse than HAR by 1 basis point per session
downside-squared loss is lower than the equal-exposure constant in at least three of four folds
primary utility is higher than the equal-exposure constant in at least three of four folds
tie_breakers: higher mean fold utility difference versus equal exposure
higher minimum fold utility difference versus HAR

comparators: constant HAR multiplier fixed to the selected candidate's mean development exposure ratio
primary_family: selected overlay minus comparator mean net return
comparator minus selected overlay downside-squared return
comparator minus selected overlay 5 percent expected-shortfall loss
selected overlay minus comparator daily downside utility at risk aversion 5
evaluation.inference: paired circular moving-block bootstrap, 20-session blocks, 9999 replications
evaluation.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg across all eight evaluation tests at q=0.05

claim_boundaries: The 2020-2023 outcomes were opened in earlier notebooks; the chronological split reduces but does not erase post-hoc research degrees of freedom.
All 1,668 candidates and the deterministic selection rule are preserved.
A result versus HAR but not the fixed equal-exposure control is mechanical de-risking rather than news timing.
The selected rule is hypothesis-generating and requires genuinely new-date confirmation.
The LSEG-33 Notebook 80 failure remains binding evidence against immediate portability.
